description.short: Query, update and service Salesforce through a Power Platform connector.
description.full: Connects Microsoft 365 Copilot to Salesforce through the Salesforce Plugin Power Platform custom connector (based on the Salesforce MCP connector). Skills cover SOQL and SOSL queries, record changes with confirmation first, reports and dashboards, Chatter, Knowledge and search synonyms, and support case triage, timelines and metrics. Every call runs as you through your Salesforce connection, so Salesforce permissions, validation rules, field-level security and sharing rules apply.

agentConnectors.description: Salesforce through the Salesforce Plugin Power Platform custom connector: SOQL and SOSL, records, schema, reports, dashboards, Chatter, Knowledge, synonyms, and support case tools.
